page.layout: Running head and page number at the top; below them one line of column headings; then one table with calendar columns (Indict., An. Iul., Lit. dom., Nabon., Feriæ., date marks, Christi), in three groups separated by rules; signature at the bottom right.

main_text.l: Indict. | An. Iul. | Lit. dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | | Christi

page.notes: The last Christi figure (622) has a mark after it that may be a stray stroke or a printing flaw; read as 622. The Christi column is cut off at the right edge of the scan, so the last digits of some rows are uncertain. Faint show-through of the other side is visible at the bottom and was left out. The date marks (27, 26, 25, 24, 23, 22, 21 Mart.) are printed beside the Feriæ column and are shown in the cell before Christi.
